title: Narrow neck of land
real_world: Isthmus of Tehuantepec (southern Mexico)
claim: Primary neck between land southward and land northward maps to Tehuantepec isthmus.
source: Sorenson limited-geo tradition; FAIR Reading Mormon’s Codex

title: Narrow pass within the neck
real_world: Elevated dry corridor through Tehuantepec (above seasonal flood plain) used by ancient/modern routes N–S
claim: Strategic pass connecting land northward/southward inside the neck; not the whole isthmus width.

title: Sea west
real_world: Pacific Ocean west of the Mesoamerican stage
claim: West sea = Pacific; Hagoth launches on west sea by the neck.

title: Sea east
real_world: Gulf of Mexico / Caribbean-facing side of the stage (exact embayment model-dependent)
claim: East sea bounds the east-sea city chain and Jershon.

title: Land southward nearly surrounded by water
real_world: Mesoamerican block south of Tehuantepec with seas east and west
claim: Small neck + seas create ‘nearly surrounded’ geography at limited scale.

title: Day-and-a-half journey on the neck line
real_world: Tehuantepec isthmus width traversable ~1.5 days for a Nephite (model day-mile band)
claim: East–west transit time across neck region fits isthmus scale under 15–20 mi/day open.

title: Land of Nephi = southern Guatemala highlands
real_world: Highland Guatemala (Valley of Guatemala region)
claim: Nephi is highland relative to Zarahemla; up/down language.

title: City of Nephi ≈ Kaminaljuyú
real_world: Kaminaljuyú, Valley of Guatemala (urbanization / wall traditions cited by Sorenson)
claim: Site-level correlation for city of Nephi; not required for relative map.
source: AAS site correlations; Codex archaeology sections

title: Land of Zarahemla = Grijalva basin
real_world: Upper/middle Grijalva depression, Chiapas / extreme southern Mexico
claim: Zarahemla lowland basin drained by Sidon.

title: City of Zarahemla ≈ Santa Rosa (upper Grijalva)
real_world: Santa Rosa site area on upper Grijalva (now inundated; still cited as correlation)
claim: Topographic isolation + mountain barrier fit cited for Santa Rosa correlation.

title: River Sidon ≈ Río Grijalva
real_world: Río Grijalva (primary Sorenson proposal; Usumacinta is a known variant)
claim: Only named river; military and settlement axis through Zarahemla land.

title: Alma 2 battle micro-topography
real_world: Upper Grijalva: hill east of river, valley of Gideon, ford back to Sidon
claim: Battle begins on hill across Sidon east of capital; pursuit to Gideon; return to ford — precise local fit claimed for upper Grijalva.

title: Gideon east of Sidon
real_world: East bank / valley east of Grijalva from Zarahemla locus
claim: Text places Gideon east of river from Zarahemla.

title: Melek west of Sidon
real_world: West of Grijalva relative to Zarahemla
claim: Melek west of Sidon; three days thence to Ammonihah.

title: Manti near head of Sidon
real_world: Upper Grijalva / highland approach south of Zarahemla basin
claim: Manti associated with headwaters / southern approach and Lamanite invasion corridors.

title: Narrow strip of wilderness (Nephi–Zarahemla barrier)
real_world: Mountain barrier between Guatemala highlands and Chiapas depression
claim: Wilderness corridor separates Nephi highlands from Zarahemla; travel days limited-theater scale.

title: Bountiful on south side of neck
real_world: Approaches to Tehuantepec from land southward (north edge of land southward)
claim: Bountiful borders Desolation at neck; fortification/pass control.

title: Desolation north of neck
real_world: North/west of Tehuantepec (Gulf / isthmian north side)
claim: Desolation and bones/Jaredite associations north of the neck line.

title: Jershon by east sea
real_world: East coastal plain of land southward, south of Bountiful approaches
claim: Ammonite land east by sea; south of Bountiful.

title: East-sea city chain (Moroni, Lehi, Morianton…)
real_world: Gulf/Caribbean coastal corridor of land southward toward the neck
claim: Coastal cities and northward flight along seashore toward land northward.

title: Hagoth shipping on west sea by neck
real_world: Pacific side near Tehuantepec — launch into land northward
claim: Shipbuilding on west sea by narrow neck; voyages northward.

title: Hill Cumorah / Ramah ≈ Cerro El Vigía region
real_world: Cerro El Vigía, Tuxtla Mountains, south-central Veracruz
claim: Final battle hill in land of many waters northward — classic limited-model southern Cumorah.

title: City of Mulek ≈ La Venta (isthmian)
real_world: La Venta region, Tabasco / isthmian lowlands
claim: East-sea / neck-adjacent city correlation in some Codex presentations.

title: Jaredite great city by narrow neck
real_world: Olmec heartland isthmian cities (e.g. San Lorenzo tradition as ‘great city by neck’ analogy)
claim: Great city by the narrow neck where sea divides land — isthmian archaeology analogy.

title: Lamanite Jerusalem ≈ Lake Atitlán submergence tradition
real_world: Lake Atitlán, Guatemala (submerged-ruin folklore used as speculative parallel)
claim: Highly speculative site link for city of Jerusalem destruction/waters; keep contested.
source: Sorenson public summaries; contested even within LDS scholarship
